coverage_notes.search_quality: DEGRADED: CMS list accessible and all twelve targeted search requests returned, but results were overwhelmingly old, international, generic, or unrelated despite 2-day recency filters. Independent fresh rural and territorial recall could not be established reliably.
coverage_notes.limitations: Bounded supplementary recall is not exhaustive. No new qualifying service change verified since previous heartbeat; no-findings is not evidence none occurred. Publication timestamps frequently lack hour-level precision, and search ranking/indexing was poor.
coverage_notes.controls: Exactly one append-only heartbeat intended for ops/watch-ledger; production collection authoritative. No approval, public publication, production changes, schedule changes, or disabling.
